title: Parts Allowance on Northgate Protect Repair Authorizations
content:
**Rule.** A parts allowance is added to the authorized repair value on a Northgate Protect single-item plan by the limit of liability registered on the plan: the high parts allowance of $60.00 when it is at least the high parts floor of $2000.00, the middle parts allowance of $30.00 when it is at least the middle parts floor of $1000.00 but below $2000.00, and nothing below $1000.00.

| Limit of liability registered on the plan | Parts allowance |
|---|---|
| $2000.00 or more | $60.00 |
| $1000.00 or more but below $2000.00 | $30.00 |
| Below $1000.00 | Nothing |

## Both sides of each floor (hypothetical registered limits)

- $2000.00 earns $60.00; $1999.99 earns $30.00.
- $1000.00 earns $30.00; $999.99 earns nothing.

The registered limit is the total of the registration entries for the covered item on the plan's ledger.
